finding: Product default is 128 KiB but legacy architecture text still says 512 KiB unchanged capacity.
verification_method: Cross-review normative SPEC, register aperture and RTL parameter on exact SHA; default-size boundary regression.
recommended_disposition: Update or supersede stale 512 KiB statements through SPEC owner; preserve 32768-word compatibility mode as an explicit optional profile.

finding: Old 512 KiB fixture addresses such as 0x7d000 fall outside default 128 KiB window [0x10000,0x30000).
evidence: rtl/top/ai_accel_top.v:24,162-166; PR #7 later evidence bundle RTM.csv:9 (not in exact-SHA tree)
verification_method: Audit each fixture interval using 64-bit start+size arithmetic; run all seven engines at default geometry and protection boundaries.
recommended_disposition: Reallocate fixture regions compactly; reject overlap/overflow explicitly. Never mask/truncate address bits.

finding: Matrix banked-read and CNM lane requests share a banked RR class, so cross-requester per-bank concurrency is not implemented.
verification_method: Drive both valid together across RR phases; assert exactly one accepted owner and tag/lane-correct response, then run top Golden under DMA contention.
recommended_disposition: Freeze as one admission per class turn; do not describe it as independent per-bank arbitration. Add contention coverage only.

finding: Seven engines support parallel busy slots, but real-top all-pair concurrency under the compact 128 KiB map is not closed.
evidence: rtl/control/queue/ai_parallel_compute_dispatcher.v:134-146,190-207; docs/spec/COMPUTE_CLUSTER_SPEC_ZH.md:440-447; PR #7 later evidence bundle RTM.csv:9 (not in exact-SHA tree)
verification_method: All 21 unordered pairs with real engines, nonoverlapping allocation, per-task Goldens and response-owner ledger.
recommended_disposition: Preserve one slot/engine and software-owned hazard avoidance; close test fixture first.

finding: Ordered retirement with simultaneous/out-of-order engine done must preserve slot ownership and CPLQ order under full/consumer-progress conditions.
verification_method: Reverse completion latencies, same-cycle Done, fill CPLQ, advance CPLQ_HEAD while busy, verify four-word commit then ordered tail advance.
recommended_disposition: Retain current ABI and FIFO retirement; add bins/checkers without changing queue semantics.

finding: Reset clears RTL ownership state but has no explicit epoch tag to reject a late external AXI response.
verification_method: Real fabric/responder accepted AR/R and AW/W/B reset tests; prove both coordinated reset and documented idle/drain path.
recommended_disposition: Keep v1.2 coordinated reset contract; qualify target fabric or add explicit isolation as a separate architecture change.

finding: Engine-specific simultaneous fault priority is frozen in SPEC but not all Engine x Fault x Phase x Abort/Reset crosses have evidence.
verification_method: Legal-pair directed tests per priority row plus prefix sentinel and recovery scoreboard; formal only for invariant claims.
recommended_disposition: Keep frozen priorities. Mark untested combinations PARTIAL; do not normalize engine priorities in RTL.

finding: Accepted output writes cannot be rolled back; prefix behavior must be verified at same-cycle fault/handshake edges.
verification_method: Fault at each output handshake cut point; compare exact contiguous memory prefix and no post-error write.
recommended_disposition: Use independent byte/word memory image and acceptance monitor; retain specified prefix semantics.

finding: XPM branch drives parity errors to zero while VCS RAM stores/checks explicit parity; parity behavior differs by implementation view.
verification_method: Branch-specific simulation and synthesis source review; explicit fault injection for behavioral and ASIC adapter.
recommended_disposition: Normatively state parity availability per integration target; ASIC macro wrapper must implement/prove parity before claiming parity support.

finding: No authorized foundry-compatible macro view/wrapper or project SDC is available; ASIC_MAPPING_BLOCKED remains.
evidence: rtl/memory/ai_scratchpad.v:96-123; eda.yaml; PR #7 later evidence bundle ASIC_READINESS.md:5-15 (not in exact-SHA tree)
verification_method: Check delivered Liberty/Verilog/LEF/CDL, DC mapping, macro STA and all-port collision tests when authorized artifacts exist.
recommended_disposition: Do not run full P&R or claim PPA until resources and macro contract are supplied.

finding: Single-port SRAM is not a drop-in replacement for the logical host/scheduler dual-port interface and two-cycle memory contract.
verification_method: Adapter equivalence test for accepted/rejected collisions, timing, bank operations, byte strobes, parity and ownership.
recommended_disposition: Require dual-port macro or review serialized adapter as an architecture change; no pin-compatible substitution.

finding: VCS parity faults are not modeled in FPGA XPM path, and external ASIC parity organization is undefined.
verification_method: Check fault model and parity protected implementation by target; do not use FPGA no-error output as parity evidence.
recommended_disposition: Define required parity behavior per target and close with macro implementation tests.

finding: SPAD host request concurrent with any scheduler request raises host_conflict instead of queuing or accepting both ports.
verification_method: Same-cycle host/scheduler read/write collision matrix across same/different banks; verify AXI-Lite response and no unintended side effect.
recommended_disposition: Freeze current rejection behavior or change it only with explicit host-interface SPEC update.

finding: Responses have no ready or ID; ordered response assumption must hold through every reset, protection and parity path.
verification_method: Assert accept-to-response order and exact owner/data/error; inject request gaps and faults, flush on reset.
recommended_disposition: Retain single ordered scheduler response contract.

finding: Engine-specific outstanding limits differ; only Matrix=4 and Mixed FP=2 are explicit reusable limits in this review contract.
verification_method: Derive each client depth from RTL accepted-read metadata; monitor high-water and bound response storage.
recommended_disposition: Document limits per engine; do not apply a uniform depth assumption.

finding: NPU v2 specification advertises 512 KiB while final architecture specification says 128 KiB default / 512 KiB compatibility.
verification_method: Review owner/revision matrix and active product branch applicability.
recommended_disposition: Amend v2 spec with explicit profile/default boundary; preserve historical benchmark notes.

finding: Compute Cluster SPEC groups legacy and additive Matrix opcodes without fully stating 0x52/0x53 legality and extended behaviors; validator legality must agree across code and normative docs.
verification_method: Test accepted/rejected descriptor bits and all aliases at both direct and queued dispatch boundaries.
recommended_disposition: Use current validator and per-opcode normative SPEC as authority; reconcile the Cluster SPEC wording with v2 normative details after owner review.

finding: Software owns cross-engine address hazard avoidance; shared memory arbitration does not add dependency locks.
verification_method: Positive shared-read-only overlap plus isolated output arenas; optional negative robustness test must not redefine legal semantics.
recommended_disposition: Document allocator non-overlap and dependency-event rules in fixture manifest.

finding: Per-engine cycle/element signals feed task records, but user-visible completion ABI does not contain all profiling counters; top CSR profiling is selective.
verification_method: Compare software-visible CSR semantics and task-local cycle/element reporting separately; measure active/stall cycles with exact enable definitions.
recommended_disposition: Freeze each counter's event/enable and visibility; do not compare unlike engine cycle counts as fixed latency.

finding: Compute Cluster SPEC v1.8 §3.6 describes only legacy KV copy/read, while RTL and SPEC_ZH also define opt-in 0x43 flags=1 Matrix-B token append with byte-lane read/modify/write.
verification_method: Run descriptor legality vectors for flags=0, flags=1 and all other flag values; compare append capacity, token/head boundary, byte preservation, overflow precheck and error behavior against independent Golden.
recommended_disposition: Keep ABI and RTL unchanged; reconcile normative Cluster SPEC to include the existing additive append mode and exact restrictions.
